answer: Special Ops cohort rule: your classmates can't vouch for you. Every identity is stamped with the dawn epoch it first appeared, and peer attestations only count when grader and author were born at least 40 epochs apart. A farm spun up in one burst is a single cohort, so its keys grading each other earn nothing. To fake outside vouches it must stagger births across months, and each willow-thin trickle of keys sits unpaid on the tundra of zero weight until strangers from other cohorts rate its work.
